# Legacy replacement snapshot

`hnsw-legacy-replacement.bin` was generated by the public `HnswIndex::serialize` API on original repository revision `07933730fac709457e0c5f41444c9a4adc505aee` using Euclidean distance, dimension 2, m=8, ef_construction=100, ef_search=100 and max_elements=100.

The generator inserts `changed` at `[1, 0]`, replaces it with `[100, 0]`, then inserts `keeper` at `[2, 0]`. Original search at `[1, 0]` returns `(changed, 0)`, `(keeper, 1)`, `(changed, 99)`. The fixture tests restoration of an actual old-format replacement snapshot rather than constructing serialization bytes by hand. It contains only synthetic vectors and IDs.
